# Week Collection

_SKOS collection in the [PKM Vocabulary](../)._

The ten parts of a Week Cluster listed flat, together with Week itself. It enumerates by hand what the hierarchy already derives; where the two disagree the hierarchy under Week Cluster is authoritative.
